news.title: Younger and LGBTQ Adults in the U.S. Stand Out for Finding Friendship Online
news.summary_en: Roughly a quarter of Americans have friends they met online, and most have met those friends in person.

news.title: At Least 10 States Require In-Person Businesses to Accept Cash
news.summary_en: At least 10 states and 10 municipalities require in-person businesses to accept cash, with some exceptions.
